evidence_used: Smooth, flat cardboard sidewalls visible on the poker chip box
Clean, dry surface condition supporting mushroom-tipped gecko adhesive pads
Box geometry allows broad parallel contact against the rigid pads
gecko.calculation_summary: Force = Base object weight scaling estimate * 0.5 (high gecko adhesion factor for clean smooth cardboard)
assumptions_and_uncertainty: No authoritative mass measurement is available; mass is visually estimated from box dimensions
Surface is assumed to be dry and free of coatings that degrade dry adhesion
Visual approximation of friction and adhesion coefficients introduces uncertainty
gecko.reasoning_trace: The poker chip box exhibits flat, smooth, clean cardboard sidewalls that are highly compatible with the gecko dry-adhesive pads. Because the gecko gripper benefits from high directional adhesion on flat, smooth surfaces, a lower normal force is required compared to purely frictional grippers. Based on visual scale estimation of the box, a moderate normal force of 1.5 N is sufficient to establish broad contact and lift the object reliably.

evidence_used: Rigid silicone gripping pads with high friction
Estimated moderate object weight from visual scale
silicone.calculation_summary: Force = Base object weight scaling estimate / silicone friction coefficient estimation
assumptions_and_uncertainty: Mass is visually estimated without physical weighing
Silicone pad local compliance is assumed sufficient to grip the flat cardboard securely
silicone.reasoning_trace: The high-friction silicone pads rely primarily on normal force and friction to hold objects since they lack dry adhesion. On smooth cardboard, the silicone gripper maintains a secure hold, but because it lacks the high-traction adhesive assist of the gecko pads, a slightly higher normal force of 2.5 N is required to prevent slip during lifting.

comparison_evidence: Smooth, flat cardboard sidewalls favorable for dry adhesive pads
Gecko gripper requires lower normal force due to specialized dry adhesion on smooth surfaces
Silicone gripper requires higher normal force relying strictly on friction
recommendation_summary: The gecko gripper is recommended because the poker chip box provides flat, smooth, and clean cardboard surfaces that maximize the performance of mushroom-tipped dry-adhesive pads, allowing for a lower required pre-grasp normal force (1.5 N) compared to the silicone gripper (2.5 N).
